name: Builder
lead: What `world.build` hands the function it is given. Coordinates are whole blocks of the build's own and may be negative; later writes win.

functions.name: block
functions.description: Sets one block of the build; later writes win.

functions.name: box
functions.signature: builder:box(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, block: string)
functions.description: Inclusive corners, in any order, like `chunk:fill`.

functions.name: line
functions.signature: builder:line(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, block: string)
functions.description: Every block the straight line between the ends passes through.

functions.name: part
functions.description: What `fn` writes is a named part, found by `citadel render --part` and `citadel check` once pasted. Nested calls name "tower/roof".

title: Builder type
